answers.ask: Is the mall lobby, the runway and the VIP wing all one continuous space, or does each mode sit on its own map reached through the portals?
answers.answer: Keep the luxury mall lobby and VIP wing as one continuous shared space, with portals leading to separate runway-show maps for rounds.

answers.ask: Are the dressing booths private per-player instances, or physical rooms in the shared lobby that anyone can walk into?
answers.answer: Dressing booths are private per-player instances, so each player can customize outfits without others entering or seeing their booth.

scene_prompt: Create a 3D fashion game layout centered on a huge, continuous luxury fashion mall lobby. A spinning central runway anchors the main hall, surrounded by glowing waterfalls, glass elevators, giant digital billboards, portals to separate runway-show maps, a daily reward fountain, trading plaza, photo studio, and event stage. Connect a VIP wing to the shared mall through sparkling golden doors, containing a luxury boutique, VIP-only dressing booths, a private runway practice room, and chat lounge. Use private per-player dressing-booth instances with smart mirrors, makeup and hair stations, accessory organizers, and clothing display sections. Include a fashion magazine display area for winning outfits.
agent_notes: Outfit creation, themed rounds and a judged runway is the Dress Up subgenre of Roleplay & Avatar Sim, with no housing model anywhere in it. Kept the Dress Up preset but replaced its stage-runway shape with space-staged, because the answers put the mall lobby and VIP wing in one continuous shared space and the runway shows on separate maps behind portals, which is exactly the lobby-isolated-from-match-area split; that P4 is stated rather than estimated, so it is not overridden, and the audience and judges stage-runway would have carried are preserved through npc-population instead. P3 comes from the VIP boutique behind the golden doors and the private per-player dressing booths, which are interiors entered from the lobby rather than facades. Decided without a user: point scoring, ranks, trading and battle passes are progression rather than layout, and both P4 and P3 are modifiers the pipeline cannot run yet, so this build should be deferred or shipped as the continuous lobby alone if it must run today.
